steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives 200 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Kielce is worth little to you alone. 200 fl cash, nearly double its price.

reply.message: Handing over a complete color set is worth far more than 200 fl. I'm not selling Kielce.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Groningen, 50 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Groningen gives you 2 of 3 Tulp (pricier group) plus 50 fl for Kielce. Fair swap toward sets for both of us.

reply.message: Not selling Kielce; giving you the full Polder set for one Tulp street isn't a fair swap.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Groningen, 100 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Groningen plus 100 fl for Kielce. That puts you at 2 of 3 Tulp, a pricier group than Polder, and it's my best offer.

reply.message: Not selling Kielce. Handing over the full Polder set for Groningen and 100 fl doesn't work for me.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Groningen, Wodociągi Wisła, 50 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Two properties plus 50 fl for one: Groningen gets you 2 of 3 Tulp, and the waterworks earns rent right away. That's about 350 fl of value for a 110 fl street.

reply.message: Not selling Kielce; handing over the full Polder set isn't worth it to me.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Groningen; haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag
steps.message: Groningen completes 2 of 3 Tulp for you alongside Toruń; Den Haag pairs with my Rotterdam. Even-ish swap that helps both of us.

reply.message: Den Haag is worth clearly more than Groningen, and it would complete a Las set path for you alongside Rotterdam. I'm declining.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Groningen; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Groningen pairs with your Lublin for 2 of 3 Tulp. It's a pricier group than Polder. A straight swap that helps us both.

reply.message: Not selling Kielce. Handing over the full Polder set for one Tulp street doesn't work for me.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives 250 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Straight cash: 250 fl for Kielce, more than double its price. That cash can go straight into houses on your own sets.

reply.message: Not selling Kielce; handing P0 the full Polder set isn't worth it for 250 fl.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Groningen, 120 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag
steps.message: Groningen plus 120 fl for Den Haag. That makes up the price gap and gives you 2 of 3 Tulp next to Toruń.

reply.message: Den Haag is worth more than Groningen plus 120 fl, and it would give you 2 of 3 Las next to Rotterdam. I'm declining.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives 150 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Radom
steps.message: 150 fl for Radom, almost double its price. Klei is the cheapest group on the board, and you can put the cash toward your bigger sets.

steps.terms: haiku-5.5 gives Radom; opus-5.5 gives 230 fl
steps.message: Radom completes your Klei set, so I need more than 150 for it. Make it 230 fl and we have a deal.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives 190 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Radom
steps.message: Meet in the middle: 190 fl for Radom, which is well over double its price.

reply.message: Deal at 190 fl for Radom.

steps.terms: heuristic gives Haarlem; haiku-5.5 gives Eindhoven, 140 fl
haiku-5.5 gives Eindhoven; heuristic gives Haarlem
steps.message: Eindhoven for Haarlem straight up, no cash either way. Cegła and Bursztyn are close in value, so I'd rather not pay the 140 on top.

steps.terms: heuristic gives Haarlem; haiku-5.5 gives Eindhoven, 140 fl

reply.message: Eindhoven for Haarlem works for me. Cegła is a set I can build on.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Groningen, 100 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Groningen plus 100 fl for Kielce. That gives you 2 of 3 Tulp next to Lublin, plus cash to build.

reply.message: Not selling Kielce; it would hand P0 the full Polder set, and Tulp still needs Toruń from P2.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Groningen, 150 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Groningen plus 150 fl for Kielce. Groningen gives you 2 of 3 Tulp next to Lublin, and the cash covers houses there.

reply.message: Not selling Kielce; it completes Polder for P0, and Tulp would still need Toruń from P2.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Groningen, 50 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag
steps.message: Groningen plus 50 fl for Den Haag. You're short on cash, and Groningen gives you 2 of 3 Tulp next to Toruń.

steps.terms: haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag; opus-5.5 gives Groningen, 150 fl
steps.message: Den Haag is worth more to me than 50 fl. Groningen plus 150 fl and we have a deal.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Groningen, 100 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag
steps.message: Meet in the middle: Groningen plus 100 fl for Den Haag.

steps.terms: haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag; opus-5.5 gives Groningen, 140 fl
steps.message: Den Haag is worth more to me than 100 fl. Groningen plus 140 fl and we have a deal.

reply.message: Deal: Groningen plus 140 fl for Den Haag.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Amsterdam Centraal, 150 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Amsterdam Centraal plus 150 fl for Kielce. That gives you 2 stations and cash to build.

reply.message: Not selling Kielce; it would complete Polder for P0, who already dominates the board.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Wodociągi Wisła, 250 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Final big offer: Wodociągi Wisła plus 250 fl for Kielce. That's a strong cash boost for building your Kaas and Tulp plans.

reply.message: Not selling Kielce; Polder would give P0 a full set and even more dominance.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Amsterdam Centraal, 300 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Amsterdam Centraal plus 300 fl for Kielce. You're low on cash; this funds houses on Kaas if you get Gdańsk, and the station pairs with Utrecht Centraal.
promises: I will not build on Polder for 3 rounds

reply.message: Not selling Kielce; it would complete Polder for P0, who already dominates the board.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives 400 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: 400 fl cash for Kielce. You're at 20 fl, so one bad roll ends your game; this keeps you alive and lets you build.
promises: I will not build on Polder for 3 rounds

reply.message: Not selling Kielce; it would complete Polder for P0.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Amsterdam Centraal, 250 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: You have 0 cash; any rent could bankrupt you. Amsterdam Centraal plus 250 fl for Kielce keeps you alive, and the station pairs with your Utrecht Centraal.

reply.message: Not selling Kielce; it would complete Polder for P0.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Amsterdam Centraal, 150 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Kraków
steps.message: Amsterdam Centraal gives you 3 stations (rent 90) plus 150 fl of cash you badly need at 85 fl.

steps.terms: haiku-5.5 gives Kraków; opus-5.5 gives Amsterdam Centraal, 250 fl
steps.message: Kraków completes Las for you, so I need more. Amsterdam Centraal plus 250 fl, and we can deal.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Amsterdam Centraal, 200 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Kraków
steps.message: Meet in the middle: Amsterdam Centraal plus 200 fl for Kraków. That gives you 3 stations and cash right away.

reply.message: Accepted. The 200 fl and a third station help me a lot right now.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Wodociągi Wisła, 100 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Wodociągi Wisła plus 100 fl for Kielce. You get a rent earner and cash to unmortgage Kaas.

reply.message: Not selling Kielce; it would complete Polder for P0, who already dominates the board.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives 150 fl; heuristic gives Kielce
steps.message: 150 fl cash for Kielce, which earns you only 8 fl rent. The cash would help you unmortgage your Kaas or Tulp properties.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives 220 fl; heuristic gives Kielce
steps.message: 220 fl for Kielce, which earns you just 8 fl. That cash can unmortgage Lublin or Wrocław for you.

steps.terms: haiku-5.5 gives 300 fl; heuristic gives Wrocław
steps.message: 300 fl for Wrocław gives you cash to start unmortgaging your other properties.

steps.terms: heuristic gives Amsterdam; haiku-5.5 gives Toruń, Groningen, 160 fl
haiku-5.5 gives Toruń, Groningen; heuristic gives Amsterdam
steps.message: Amsterdam for Toruń and Groningen, no extra cash. You get two Tulp streets back in trade, and P3 keeps the cash.

steps.terms: heuristic gives Amsterdam; haiku-5.5 gives Toruń, Groningen, 180 fl

reply.message: Accepted. Amsterdam completes my Wisła set with Warszawa.

reasoning.text: Cheap property early with plenty of cash; it starts building toward the Polder group, which is cheap to develop.
Early game with plenty of cash; buying Kielce is cheap, blocks P0's Polder group and gives trade leverage.
Toruń starts a color group I can build on, and at 150 fl with 1500 cash it is affordable and gives a strong long-run asset.
Amsterdam is the top-rent property and gives me half of Wisła; 980 fl left after buying is plenty of cash this early.
I have plenty of cash (1390 fl), and owning Lublin gives me a stake in the Tulp group, which I can trade on or use to block P2 from completing it.
Łódź is the first property of the Cegła group, and owning the full set would allow doubled rent and building. With 1350 fl cash, paying 240 keeps a healthy reserve.
Radom is a cheap Klei street with 80 fl price and 1310 cash, so buying is affordable and starts a color group toward full set with Lelystad.
This gives me 2 of the 3 Polder streets and blocks P1, and it's cheap with plenty of cash left over. It also sets up a trade for Kielce.
Completing Polder gives me a cheap full set that is fast to build on, so overpaying for Kielce is worth it.
Giving P0 the full Polder set lets them build and collect high rents. 200 fl is too little for that.
No need to mortgage with 1193 cash; keep properties and avoid unnecessary moves.
Szczecin completes a path toward the Cegła color group with my Łódź, and I have ample cash (1234) to absorb the 270 price while keeping a reserve.
Early in the game, buying blocks the Tulp group from P1 and P2 and gives me trade leverage, possibly for Kielce. Cash stays comfortable.
Completing Polder is cheap and strong; Groningen sweetens it for P1.
Accepting would give P0 a complete Polder set, and I would still lack the third Tulp, Toruń, which P2 owns. That makes the deal bad for me.
I have plenty of cash and no need to mortgage. Nothing worth building or trading right now.
I have 1131 cash and no pressing debt, and I own no full color group to build on, so mortgaging would only lose rent income. Doing nothing keeps my Klei, Tulp and Cegła streets earning.
Utilities give steady income and serve as trade bait, and after buying I keep 733 fl, which is plenty of cash. Early in the game, acquiring property is valuable.
I'm keeping my cash for now; P1 has refused to sell Kielce twice, so another offer is unlikely to succeed.
Many properties are still unowned, so getting back on the board quickly to buy them is worth 50 fl, and I have plenty of cash.
No set to build on and plenty of cash; mortgaging gains nothing, so I hold.

I have 1119 cash, no pressure to mortgage, and the only options are mortgages which would give up rent income from my color groups. Doing nothing keeps my Klei, Tulp, and Cegła properties earning rent.
A station is a solid income asset, and buying it still leaves 582 fl in reserve. It also starts a station collection.
Completing Polder lets me build cheap houses early; I'm adding more to the earlier offer P1 rejected.
Accepting would give P0 a complete Polder set and leave me with a weak 2/3 Tulp, so I'm rejecting.
I have 1139 fl, so 310 is affordable. Wrocław starts a Kaas set, and Gdańsk and Leiden are both still unowned.
No need to mortgage with 829 cash; keep properties and wait for better opportunities.
